title: Keep historical blend inventory diagnostics in the background

changes.title: Remove routine historical inventory audit from Vial Actions
changes.detail: Historical blend source evidence is assessed internally without showing an Inventory needs review task or asking users to manually audit old dose records.

changes.title: Preserve unknown historical physical amounts
changes.detail: Missing or mismatched source allocations remain unresolved; the read-only evidence engine never infers physical stock, reopens vials, rewrites historical doses or changes balances.

changes.title: Retain Deadpool and BAC-water accounting safeguards
changes.detail: The released exact-vial automatic-finish and per-vial BAC-water workflows remain unchanged and passed fictional full-app, writer, mobile, WebKit and next-day regression checks.

dataImpact: No migration, automatic stock correction, historical inventory reconciliation, reattribution, vial reopening or overwrite. Existing localStorage key peptide-tracker-html-v1 and records preserved. Ordinary user-confirmed doses continue to log as before. Isolated full-app DEMO uses fictional in-memory data with no production sync/import/writes.
limitations: Read-only diagnostic evidence is internal; no automatic stock-repair or on-demand exception prompt system is introduced.
Unknown physical vial contents cannot be established by incomplete historic logs; already-finished historical vials remain untouched.
PR169 multi-source Review/Undo remains a separate unmerged draft.
User confirmed physical iPhone review of Stash/Vial Actions and Log Dose with no issues. VoiceOver and real historical physical-stock accuracy were not tested.
Publication pending; primary Cloudflare exact merged-source parity must be independently verified after approved merge.

history.title: Safeguard exact premixed-vial status during daily dose logging
history.verification: Cloudflare 16/16 exact source parity; workflows #44033882596 and #44034237308

changes.title: Prevent premature Finished status for premixed vials
changes.detail: Automatic vial depletion now requires verified same-vial dose, waste or correction evidence, rather than kit-wide balance alone. Unattributed older entries cannot retire a specific open vial.

changes.title: Protect open premixed vials during preparation
changes.detail: Generic Prepare Dose rollover cannot retire an active premixed vial before physical-ledger commitment; it fails closed without changing inventory.

changes.title: Validate repeated dose logging across days
changes.detail: Fictional automated browser checks cover dose, durable save/readback, reload and next-day dose at 320px and 390px in light and dark modes, including historical unattributed entries.

history.dataImpact: No migration, automatic reopening, historical Deadpool inventory reconciliation, correction or stock credit. Existing saved records and localStorage key peptide-tracker-html-v1 are retained. Future ordinary user-confirmed dose logs continue to write normally. Fictional DEMO remains isolated, without live writes/import/sync.

history.title: Reliable premixed-blend combination doses and accurate per-vial BAC-water records

changes.title: Prevent premature empty vials when logging premixed-blend combinations
changes.detail: Combination-dose logs now debit the blend's exact physical vial ledger, retain positive source allocations and undo identity, and roll back staged inventory if source confirmation fails.

changes.title: Record confirmed BAC water on the physical vial
changes.detail: Tapping Log Reconstitution confirms the amount shown, including an unchanged default. New standard and blend vial records retain their own exact BAC water and linked preparation history.

changes.title: Safely correct historical vial preparation records
changes.detail: Finished-vial BAC amounts can be explicitly confirmed without reopening stock, changing remaining amounts or fabricating an unknown date. Kit defaults stay labelled unverified when exact historical evidence is absent.

history.dataImpact: No automatic migration, backfill, repair or overwrite of saved dose history, inventory, current protocols, or browser localStorage (peptide-tracker-html-v1). Future explicit Log Reconstitution actions save the chosen BAC amount on the exact vial and append linked history. Historical Deadpool records marked empty despite missing source allocations are NOT silently restored or modified. Isolated full-app DEMO uses fictional in-memory data with no live writes or sync.
